mesh2motion.sourceArtRepository: https://github.com/Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-assets (CC0-1.0 LICENSE; Blender 4.5/5.0 sources — not openable in this machine's Blender 3.4, GLBs used instead)

licenses.art: CC0 1.0 (LICENSE-CC0.MD: "All 3d models, blend files, rigs, animations")
licenses.perVariation: src/lib/RigConfig.ts: base = Quaternius (no override = CC0); sintel/jay/bunny = Blender Studio CC-BY; sophia = Tysan Tan CC-SA 4.0; psx-* = elbolilloduro (no override). Only the base model is used.

mesh2motion.humanRig: 66 joints incl. leaf bones, UE-mannequin names, fingers 3 joints + leaf, no twist bones; animations: rotation keys + pelvis location, no root motion (ANIMATOR-README.md); app animation GLBs use EXT_meshopt_compression
mesh2motion.notUsed: Mesh2Motion animations (punch-jab, punch-cross, melee-hook, fighting-idle) were downloaded for inspection only; the MARTIALDEX cross/hook are authored from scratch.

rigComparison.note: Same test poses on each rig (scripts/motion3d/rig_pose_test.py). skinAreaRatio = triangle area vs rest per region [min, max]; newIntersections = triangle pairs over the rest pose.
